data.name: Tropicarbon
data.description: Tropicarbon is a Colombia-based pure-play CDR startup founded in 2023 that deploys enhanced rock weathering on tropical farmland in partnership with local farmers and Universidad del Norte. It operates greenhouse and field-scale trials (including the Barranquilla Project) and develops proprietary MRV aligned with Isometric and Puro.Earth protocols.
